description: Evaluate a candidate action against the repo's DECIONIS_POLICY.md — or, with policy_pack, against one of the Decionis policy packs (decionis_list_policy_packs) — through the real Decionis protocol evaluator, entirely locally (no network, no credentials, nothing recorded). The exact policy version is pinned on every call; an unavailable version fails closed rather than silently deciding under another bundle. Call this BEFORE committing, deploying, migrating, or any risky action, and abide by the verdict: allow → proceed; block → do not proceed; review/escalate → stop and involve a human (an ESCALATE in enforce mode returns an evaluation_id that decionis_request_presence_verification can resolve when Presence is configured).

payload.description: The candidate action, e.g. {"action": "production-deploy", "change_freeze": true, "agent_generated": true}

policy_pack.description: Evaluate under a named Decionis policy pack (a key from decionis_list_policy_packs, e.g. finance, devops, sap) instead of the repository policy file. The pack's bundle is seeded into the local evaluator once and its exact version is pinned.

workflow_key.description: Optional workflow key for the gated surface.

name: decionis_evaluate
title: Evaluate Candidate Action Locally
